text: About 2.2% of the property (81.3 hectares out of 3,643.5 hectares) was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. This loss was primarily in planted forests (68.1 hectares of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with a smaller portion (13.2 hectares) outside mapped forest areas. The data excludes minor patches under 0.5 hectares (37.3 hectares total). The loss was confirmed by satellite observations and corroborated by a 2020 reference map, but the cause (e.g., harvesting, fire, or natural causes) and legality remain undetermined.
